Visitor skips all input elements

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitInput(NodeContext ctx, String inputType, String name, String value) {
                return new VisitResult.Skip();
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>Sign up:</p><input type=\"text\" name=\"email\" placeholder=\"your@email.com\"><input type=\"checkbox\" name=\"agree\"><p>Continue</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
